scripts.setup:frontend: npm run deploy:frontend && npm run db:frontend:schema && npm run db:frontend:seed && npm run cf-typegen:frontend
scripts.db:frontend:schema: npx wrangler@4.128.0 d1 execute DB --config wrangler.frontend.jsonc --remote --file schema.sql --profile personal
scripts.db:frontend:seed: npx wrangler@4.128.0 d1 execute DB --config wrangler.frontend.jsonc --remote --file demo-seed.sql --profile personal
scripts.test:frontend-db: wrangler d1 execute DB --config wrangler.frontend.jsonc --local --file schema.sql && wrangler d1 execute DB --config wrangler.frontend.jsonc --local --file demo-seed.sql && wrangler d1 execute DB --config wrangler.frontend.jsonc --local --command "SELECT COUNT(*) AS demo_projects FROM projects WHERE id LIKE 'demo-%';"
